briefs.background: A canned cold brew is launching in campus-area stores. Focus on the between-class coffee run.
briefs.audience: Students ages 18–24 who buy iced coffee regularly and value convenience.
briefs.objective: Encourage students to try one can during launch month.
briefs.singleMessage: Cold brew for the between-class break.
briefs.reasonToBelieve: Supplied fictional scenario facts: canned cold brew, stocked in campus market coolers; no taste, price or energy comparison is approved.

thinkFeelDo.think: A coffee break fits my schedule.
thinkFeelDo.do: Try a can from the cooler.

briefs.mandatory: Show the can. Include: Find it in the campus market cooler starting October 27.
briefs.constraints: No health, energy, speed, taste superiority or price claims. Do not invent product proof.

briefs.background: A resale app wants students to see its listings as curated vintage rather than simply used clothing.
briefs.audience: Thrift-curious students ages 18–29 who want a considered personal style.
briefs.objective: Encourage students to browse the curated Friday drop.
briefs.reasonToBelieve: Supplied fictional scenario facts: each listed piece is inspected, steamed and photographed before listing.
briefs.constraints: Do not mock fast-fashion buyers. No environmental benefits, exclusivity or availability claims beyond supplied facts.

briefs.background: A fictional roommate introduction app is preparing for housing selection in March.
briefs.audience: Incoming first-year students who want to discuss routines before choosing a roommate.
briefs.objective: Encourage students to download the app and take its preferences quiz.
briefs.singleMessage: Start the roommate conversation before move-in.
briefs.reasonToBelieve: Supplied fictional scenario facts: a quiz about routines and preferences; students choose what to share. No success statistics are supplied.

thinkFeelDo.think: I can start with a conversation.
thinkFeelDo.do: Download the app and take the quiz.

briefs.mandatory: Include: Take the preferences quiz before March housing selection.
briefs.constraints: No matching guarantees, friendship promises or invented usage figures. Never show real student profiles or imply GVSU endorsement.

briefs.background: A fictional repair shop near campus wants students to consider a local assessment instead of defaulting to mail-in service.
briefs.audience: Students with cracked screens who rely on their phone daily and need price clarity.
briefs.objective: Encourage walk-ins for an assessment during midterms.
briefs.singleMessage: Start your screen repair close to campus.
briefs.reasonToBelieve: Supplied fictional scenario facts: technicians provide an assessment and a price quote before repair. No repair time is approved.
briefs.mandatory: Include: 48 West Fulton, weekdays 9 to 6. This is a fictional classroom address.
briefs.constraints: No same-day or between-class repair promises. No cheapest, certification or price comparison claims.

briefs.background: A fictional three-day lakeside music festival is opening early-bird sales before its lineup announcement.
briefs.audience: West Michigan adults ages 18–34 planning summer activities.
briefs.objective: Encourage early-bird ticket purchases before May 1.
briefs.singleMessage: Three days, two stages, one shoreline.
briefs.reasonToBelieve: Supplied fictional scenario facts: a three-day event with two stages beside a shoreline. No popularity or sales figures are supplied.

thinkFeelDo.do: Review event details and buy an early-bird ticket.

briefs.mandatory: Include: Early-bird ends May 1. Link in bio to tickets.
briefs.constraints: No unconfirmed artists, crowd-size claims, most-photographed claims or guaranteed experiences.

briefs.background: A fictional reading program pairs trained college volunteers with elementary students for weekly reading sessions.
briefs.audience: College students seeking a practical service opportunity.
briefs.objective: Encourage students to sign up for volunteer training.
briefs.singleMessage: Share one hour a week reading together.
briefs.reasonToBelieve: Supplied fictional scenario facts: two-hour volunteer training, weekly one-hour reading sessions on campus. No literacy outcomes are supplied.

thinkFeelDo.think: I can make time to participate.

briefs.mandatory: Include: No experience needed; training provided. Sign up for training.
briefs.constraints: No promises of improved literacy. Do not show real children’s faces or names, invent testimony or use guilt.
